heading.title: Registration of Institutions for Persons with Disabilities and Grants to Such Institutions

article.title: Act not to apply to institutions established or maintained by Central or State Government.
article.content:
54Act not to apply to institutions established or maintained by Central or State Government.

Section 54  ·  Chapter IX  ·  page 21 of the Act
Nothing contained in this Chapter shall apply to an institution for persons with disabilities established or maintained by the Central Government or a State Government.
